scope: Independent read-only review of four typed-model-repair previews; no native, code, test, or Git change.

reviews.evidence: $container[<Workflow Run> OR <Step Run>] binds one participant over the union, and {::1} applies once over that whole union rather than per kind.
[<Workflow Run> OR <Step Run>] is one union value domain and a participant selected from it is one binding; format annotations remain direct-value domains and do not create instances or Nodes.
$relation[<Relation>] is typed; literal or constraint-data endpoints are limited to HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE and HAS_VALUE_CONSTRAINT Targets and their declared derived-inverse Hosts.

Target-omitted HAS_INSTANCE {::0+} retains the declared-domain outgoing permission. The removed Node.**//{::0..1} global bound is not replaced; Current R2243 and R2487 preserve the named applicable Property maximum of one occurrence per corresponding bearer. No <Node.**> domain is introduced.

limitations: The approved kind-union OR semantics are reviewed only as used by R2804/R2248; defining Rules remain outside this review.
This is not native-Draft adoption or runtime validation.
